contract.nonzero: Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom calls Frame_RunServicePass instead of waiting through Frame_WaitForVBlankWork.
contract.zero: Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom takes the normal Frame_WaitForVBlankWork path.
contract.lifecycle: System_InitializeRuntime clears the selector; Menu_RunOptionsPresentationContinuation brackets two palette transitions with set/clear pairs.

conclusion: FFF11B is a shared presentation fast-path selector, not palette data or persistent scene state.
